verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents a large network ("Choose from 2500+ locations") with a location finder, and notes that capabilities vary by site ("Select locations offer check deposit"). However, nothing confirms coverage across multiple countries or a per-location capability view available before signup. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of international (multi-country) locations, documented per-location capability or feature listings viewable pre-signup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, I can pick from a broad network of locations — multiple states and countries — and see each location's capabilities before signing up

citations.quote: Choose from 2500+ locations and get your digital mailbox today!
Signing Up For Multiple Mailboxes in Different Locations
